Top highlights

About this item
Care instructions
For complete leather care: Step 1 - Saddle Soap (Clean & Prepare): Brush away dirt, work into a light lather, then wipe clean. Step 2 - Mink Oil (Condition & Restore): Apply a thin, even layer to help soften and nourish the leather. Step 3 - Waterproofing Wax/Cream (Protect & Seal): Spread evenly, then buff for a protected, water-resistant finish. Use a horsehair brush to remove dust and buff, an applicator brush to spread oil/wax evenly, and a detail brush for seams and welts. Can be used together for full care or individually as needed.
Country of origin
China

About this item

  • CLEAN, CONDITION & PROTECT WORN LEATHER BOOTS — Bring dull, dusty and dry leather back to a cleaner, richer-looking finish. Saddle soap lifts everyday dirt and buildup, mink oil helps replenish lost moisture, and waterproofing wax adds a protective barrier against water, mud and daily wear.
  • COMPLETE BOOT CARE SYSTEM IN ONE KIT — No need to buy separate cleaners, conditioners, waxes or brushes. This 10-piece leather boot care kit includes saddle soap, mink oil, waterproofing wax, three horsehair brushes, polishing cloths and a storage bag for complete care from start to finish.
  • THREE FULL-SIZE FORMULAS FOR DEEPER CARE — Includes 2.12 oz of saddle soap, 2.12 oz of mink oil and 2.12 oz of waterproofing wax. Each formula performs a separate job, helping clean away grime, soften dry leather, restore a richer appearance and protect boots beyond a quick surface shine.
  • DEDICATED TOOLS FOR CLEANER, MORE EVEN RESULTS — Use the large horsehair brush to remove dust and buff the leather, the applicator brush to spread oil and wax evenly, and the detail brush to reach seams, welts and hard-to-clean edges. Separate tools help reduce mess and prevent product buildup.
  • MADE FOR BOOTS & SHOES - Suitable for work boots, cowboy boots, and leather shoes, this kit is ideal for anyone who values proper leather care. Whether used for routine maintenance or seasonal conditioning, it makes a practical and refined gift for men who take pride in their footwear and leather goods.
